conventions.effects: data/gear.json effect rows; the battle sim fires them as one more gear source on the hero
conventions.left_to_intrinsic_passives: battle-start Health/Power and Power-vs clauses it already applies
conventions.unscoped_negative: applies to enemies, as data/intrinsic_passives.json reads red aura text
conventions.immune: stun_immune and the other *_immune flags hold through PvP trims and enemy resist cuts
conventions.target_rules: target_match, target_avoid and assassinate_match steer the scope/who attackers toward or away from the vs heroes
conventions.per: the value counts once per allied hero matching per; per_self counts the hero itself too
conventions.by: a trigger fires only when the hero that was hit, attacked or died matches by
